reservation_rules: Reserve before any remote optimizer work.
Reject a reconstruction launch if remaining cumulative time or remaining reconstruction reservation is insufficient for its declared segment.
Charge only measured actual new GPU optimizer-training seconds, append one durable record per completed or interrupted segment, and never edit prior records.
At 7200 reconstruction seconds, stop optimizer work, checkpoint/save/finalize, then escalate to Director if the frozen 2M-token recipe has not completed.
At 28800 cumulative seconds, stop optimizer work, checkpoint/save/finalize; no post-cap optimizer step is permitted.
Evaluation and orchestration time are tracked separately and cannot be charged as training time or used to evade the cap.
